_note: Story mode campaigns (main menu STORY-MODUS, src/main_menu.gd). One entry per story in menu order. number: the story's number on its card. title / subtitle: card text. playable: false shows the card locked with BALD. dungeon: room library the story runs on (res:// path, only for playable stories). scene: a story with its own scene (res:// path) opens that scene instead of the hero choice and the crypt run. A new story is added by appending an entry here.
